entities.summary: Jorge Cardoso [full name: Jorge Ruben Cardoso Krieger] is a classical guitarist, composer, researcher, medical doctor and teacher. He has performed in Europe, America, Asia and Africa, and has frequently participated in international festivals, conferences, seminars, radio and television.
